summary: Live-data, agentic-simulation, and digital-twin platform for complex operations.
editor_note: Planning moves from disconnected models into one environment where data, simulations, and agents can be evaluated together. Worldscape exposes an SDK preview, API documentation, marketplace, and four logistics, data-center, telecom, and mission-planning workflows. That gives the decision-fabric pitch a product surface. The open test is whether customers can build and validate reusable simulations quickly enough for the platform to become infrastructure rather than bespoke mission engineering.

product_evidence.claim: Worldscape publicly exposes a platform, SDK preview, developer quick start, documentation, marketplace, pricing, and security surfaces for building applications on its data fabric.
The site describes concrete workflows spanning supplier and schedule visibility, data-center digital twins, telecom disruption planning, and mission-course simulation.

market_context.primary_user: Government and enterprise teams planning complex, data-intensive operations.
market_context.differentiation: A single environment joins distributed live data, digital engineering, large-scale simulation, and agentic decision workflows with a developer layer.
market_context.why_now: The $10M seed extension accompanies a visible SDK and marketplace push beyond project-specific mission engineering.

risks.claim: The platform may remain dependent on high-touch mission engineering if customers cannot independently build, validate, and reuse simulations through the SDK.
risks.basis: The official site exposes developer surfaces and use cases, but does not publish time-to-production or independent simulation-accuracy benchmarks.
